rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A TypeScript-based MCP server for managing and retrieving OpenAPI documentation, providing tools to list API groups, retrieve API details, and search APIs across both remote and local JSON specifications. Supports auto-refreshing documentation and offers a CLI interface for easy interaction with OpenAPI specs, making it straightforward to explore and understand complex API landscapes.
